en: Ah, a Trainer! Welcome to Camphrier. I am Aubert, keeper of the old castle you see behind me.
You'll be wanting the road south to the coast, I expect. I'm sorry to say a Snorlax has gone to sleep right across it.
Nothing wakes it. We've tried singing, shouting, a brass band... It only rolled over.
But the palace at the head of the avenue north keeps an old flute, and its tune is said to wake any sleeper.
Go up Route 6 and ask at the palace gate. Tell them Aubert sent you.
